description: Window control and self-update. Window: dragging the title bar, minimising and closing — on Windows and Linux the window is created undecorated, so the app's own caption buttons are the only ones the user has (see buildChrome in apps/web/lib/app.js). Update: `updater:default` lets the app ask its endpoint whether a newer signed build exists and install it, and `process:allow-restart` is what completes the install — without it the new version sits on disk until the user happens to quit and reopen. Both are granted HERE rather than in default.json because a phone updates through its store and has no window to drive either, so the two capabilities have the same platform list for the same reason. `dialog:allow-ask` / `dialog:allow-message` draw the update question and its answer: the app has no general modal of its own, and a two-button question is something the OS draws better than a component invented for it would.
